tagline: The marketing agents for the informal economy's worker agent — selling Conquest Designer without overclaiming.

product.name: Conquest Designer
product.what: The informal-economy worker agent. A buyer pays R10,000; it deploys that capital into any MaDlamini business (any of ~1,000 informal trades; business type is irrelevant and never a gate).
product.returns: R83/month for 36 months (R10,000 x 10%), then in year 3 it buys itself back and gains autonomy.
product.coupon_rule: The coupon is swept as gross revenue minus COGS. The only financial check is the revenue line and the cost line; there is no microscopic underwriting of the underlying business. The buying decision is about a standardized, investible instrument.

new_element: The marketing agent system that drives paying, committing traffic to buy Conquest Designers.
problem: Capital reaches the informal economy blind or through predatory marketing. A coupon is only real if it is backed by a business's swept revenue minus COGS, and the data that proves it — the lead stream, the designer register and the sweep pool — is fragmented and the sources disagree.
target_user: The Conquest growth operator, who must drive paying, committing buyers at volume without overclaiming.
decision_supported: Who to approach, what to say, and whether to sell at all for a given market.
output: A compliant, evidence-backed outreach plan; record-only gated_intent rows (buy-Conquest-Designer intents); a per-buyer CAC; and a refusal/escalation ledger.

sponsor_tech.zetaris: Federates the three disagreeing sources (lead stream, designer register, sweep pool) in place into one virtual view for the evidence step — no data movement, no ETL — and derives coupon coverage (swept revenue minus COGS vs the R83 obligation).
sponsor_tech.meterless: Cognition layer. World Model grounds the three disconnected sources into one canonical, provenance-stamped shared state (content-hash stable IDs, idempotent/resumable JSONL append log); H-MEM provides tiered shared memory across touches; Markovian provides the bounded cadence/decision loop and a projected-vs-actual savings log.
sponsor_tech.cursor: The development environment for the whole build; project rules are committed in .cursor/rules/conquest.mdc (SAMPLE_MODE-first, no secrets, no-hype copy, bounded loops).
sponsor_tech.nvidia: Nemotron via the NIM API powers the reason/draft/critique steps through one injected generator, with a deterministic SAMPLE_MODE fallback.

pre_existing_components: WardByWard backend (SurrealDB SCHEMAFULL schema, AgentRuntime lifecycle, nextIngulaAccount mint rail) deployed at wardbyward.co.za — declared, not resubmitted.
The Conquest Designer worker agent and the /conquest surface on wardbyward.co.za — declared pre-existing.
The pre-window scaffold in this repository (git tag 'pre-window-scaffold'): sponsor adapters, sample data, this metadata, README, .cursor/rules — declared pre-existing.

mission: Informal-sector economic vitality across the developing world, by channeling honest, agent-mediated capital to real unbanked businesses.
roadmap_aspirational: A containerised NVIDIA-GPU inference super server.
Self-hosted real-time comms (coturn) over dedicated international backhaul for low-connectivity regions.
Stated as post-event future work; not part of this build.
limitations: No real payment clearing or bank settlement is implemented.
Values are synthetic; nothing here moves money (intents are gated/escalated/record-only).
No industry classification is performed, by design.
SAMPLE_MODE is deterministic, not a model-quality benchmark.
